status: Implemented locally on experimental/cq-voxelspace. Native, simulated, rendered and loopback checks; no new live headset validation or remote deployment.

findings.report: Target designator emits no visible laser.
findings.change: Include held airstrike designator and draw an emissive camera-facing beam from the modeled muzzle.

findings.report: Medic injector is missing; a blaster pistol appears instead.
findings.change: Fix medical utility identifier and preserve injector equipment slot; mount at back of hip.

findings.report: Raise red dot and adjust zeroing so the barrel does not obstruct it.
findings.change: Apply slight 4.2 mm asset-space rise (15% of 28 mm reticle window); explicit 50 m zero shared with native ballistics. Keep optic housing unchanged.

findings.report: Armed shocktroop grenade is not launched when thrown.
findings.change: Bind arming and release to physical throwing hand; preserve recent peak throw motion through release.

findings.report: Technician drill is replaced by the primary launcher.
findings.change: Fix engineering utility identifier and preserve repair-tool slot; mount at back of hip.

findings.report: Medic and technician cannot deploy boxes.
findings.change: Give class boxes a separate reachable shoulder model and reliable native deploy action independent of gun switching cooldown.

findings.report: Offhand pistol grip forces the weapon angle downwards.
findings.change: Keep pistol wrist orientation during offhand stabilization.

findings.report: Move transport driver and cabin passenger positions slightly forward.
findings.change: Move front two seats 0.25 m forward in shared runtime/native geometry.

findings.report: Hide HUD while viewing through a scope.
findings.change: Exclude HUD and readouts from scope camera and hide stereo status surface during scope use.

findings.report: Keep map and menu in front of the player while locomoting.
findings.change: Follow locomotion/body yaw using a fixed body-relative menu transform.

findings.report: Reauthor jungle ambience to remove cityscape sounds and lower overall ambience volume.
findings.change: Reauthor original deterministic air/insect/bird loops without urban recordings; lower jungle beds 8 dB and other beds 6 dB.
Increase running/crawling grass by 3 dB; walking remains silent.

findings.report: Restore charging information on the Massacre launcher info panel.
findings.change: Restore a gun-mounted charge percentage/time/ready/reloading label above launcher geometry.
Increase native and presentation transport forward/reverse speed 20% to 12/6 m/s.

findings.report: Water kills the player before there is an opportunity to swim.
findings.change: Native bounded swim movement and buoyancy, 12-second breathing reserve, then gradual drowning damage.

findings.report: Suicide requires multiple button presses to register.
findings.change: Accept authenticated alive-player suicide with blocked or stale movement input; retain lifecycle guards.
Use controller grip frame, rotate authored Y cylinder to thumb axis, retain original 18 cm size; stowed transform remains independent.
